description: This file provides utility functions for handling versioned settings, including comparing semantic versions, checking minimum versions, finding the highest matching version, and resolving settings based on the current plugin version. It also imports external modules for semantic comparison and package information.

methods.name: isNightlyBuild
methods.description: Determines if the current build is a nightly build based on the package name.

methods.name: compareSemver
methods.description: Compares two semantic version strings using the semver-compare library, ignoring pre-release suffixes.

methods.name: meetsMinimumVersion
methods.description: Checks if the current plugin version meets or exceeds a specified minimum version.

methods.name: findHighestMatchingVersion
methods.description: Finds the highest version from a set of versioned settings that is less than or equal to the current plugin version, with special handling for nightly builds.

methods.name: resolveVersionedSettings
methods.description: Resolves and returns the settings for the highest applicable version based on the current plugin version.
